question: What is the maximum number of times that a course shows up in different transcripts and what is that course's enrollment id?

attempts.raw_output:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT tc.transcript_id) AS maximum_transcript_count,
    sec.student_enrolment_id
FROM Transcript_Contents AS tc
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS sec
    ON tc.student_course_id = sec.student_course_id
GROUP BY sec.course_id, sec.student_enrolment_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tc.transcript_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(transcript_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tc2.transcript_id) AS transcript_count
        FROM Transcript_Contents AS tc2
        JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS sec2
            ON tc2.student_course_id = sec2.student_course_id
        GROUP BY sec2.course_id
    ) AS course_counts
)

final_sql: SELECT     COUNT(DISTINCT tc.transcript_id) AS maximum_transcript_count,     sec.student_enrolment_id FROM Transcript_Contents AS tc JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS sec     ON tc.student_course_id = sec.student_course_id GROUP BY sec.course_id, sec.student_enrolment_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tc.transcript_id) = (     SELECT MAX(transcript_count)     FROM (         SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tc2.transcript_id) AS transcript_count         FROM Transcript_Contents AS tc2         JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS sec2             ON tc2.student_course_id = sec2.student_course_id         GROUP BY sec2.course_id     ) AS course_counts );
